description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'CompressedTextureActivity' that demonstrates the use of ETC1 format compressed textures in OpenGL ES. It includes methods to load textures from resources or create them dynamically at runtime, utilizing the ETC1Util utility class for compression and decompression processes.

classes.name: CompressedTextureActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating compressed texture usage with internal classes for loading textures from resources and dynamically creating textures.

classes.name: CompressedTextureActivity.CompressedTextureLoader
classes.description: Inner class for loading a compressed texture from APK resources.

classes.name: CompressedTextureActivity.SyntheticCompressedTextureLoader
classes.description: Inner class for creating and loading a compressed texture at runtime programmatically.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup of the activity, including creating a GLSurfaceView and setting its renderer.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause state, pausing the GLSurfaceView.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume state, resuming the GLSurfaceView.
